claim: Independent standard-SFT implementation of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct + public CityInstruction-London. Not an author-supplied CityGPT checkpoint, not a claim of exact numerical reproduction, and not SWFT.

data.city_rationale: One English-city public corpus, fixed before target validation. No city choice or data selection based on SOSR validation/test accuracy.
data.split: Group by SHA256 of canonical system/history/instruction/input (excluding final answer); SHA256('42|'+group_hash) modulo 1000 below 100 is domain validation, otherwise training. Identical prompts cannot cross the split.
data.training_subset: All valid training-part records, one epoch; no 12k/30k subsampling.
data.domain_validation_probe: First 512 valid validation records ordered by (group_hash, original_index); diagnostic loss only, not checkpoint selection.

tokenization.template: Unmodified local official Qwen chat template
tokenization.supervise: All tokens fully contained in assistant content/closing-separator character spans, using fast-tokenizer offsets on the single rendered full conversation. Tokens crossing an assistant/header boundary are masked, as are all system/user/header tokens.
tokenization.truncation: Right truncate after full conversation encoding; record all truncation. Exclude only rows with zero surviving supervised next-token targets.

training.last_batch: Use all remaining records exactly once; zero-weight dummy microbatches only to align distributed collectives, never duplicate contributions.
training.objective: Global supervised-token mean cross entropy per optimizer update; FP32 gradient reduction.
training.distribution: Native PyTorch FSDP full sharding, per Qwen2 decoder block
training.precision: FP32 master parameters and Adam states; BF16 forward/backward computation; FP32 reduction
training.shuffle: Fixed seed42 NumPy generator permutation of prepared training indices
training.checkpoint_selection: Final one-epoch checkpoint only, fixed before validation. Intermediate model-only checkpoints are for audit, not target-metric selection.
training.resume_policy: No automatic restart or continuation from model-only checkpoints.
training.determinism: Fixed random seeds and recorded software; not a promise of bitwise identity across GPUs/software versions.

implementation_differences: Independent trainer using current installed PyTorch/Transformers rather than the author's old LLaMA-Factory/DeepSpeed runtime.
Qwen base model and London public corpus are explicitly selected; the supplied upstream example YAML targets Llama3 and a different city.
Learning rate/epoch/global batch/cutoff/cosine/warmup are borrowed from the inspected full-SFT example as a declared recipe, not claimed to be confirmed original-Qwen hyperparameters.
Non-packed samples and deterministic prompt-group validation split instead of silently inheriting upstream packing/random-split defaults.
No extra generic instruction mixture is appended to the already mixed public corpus.
No SWFT weighting, no SOSR supervised task fine-tuning, no model architecture changes.

preflight.failure_policy: Preserve attempt directory and logs, stop; implementation fixes require a new preflight attempt, not silent scientific-setting changes.
